description: This file contains memory-related utility functions for the Revive Adserver project, including functions to get memory limits, check if limits can be set, and increase memory limits.

methods.name: OX_getMinimumRequiredMemory
methods.description: Returns the minimum required memory in bytes based on a specified limit level.

methods.name: OX_getMemoryLimitSizeInBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the current PHP memory limit in bytes.

methods.name: OX_checkMemoryCanBeSet
methods.description: Checks if the PHP memory limit can be changed.

methods.name: OX_increaseMemoryLimit
methods.description: Attempts to increase the PHP memory limit to a specified size.
